I found some money (1 note of Bangladeshi 500 Taka, equivalent to US $7) at the Masjid premise (that leads to the entrance/exit of the Masjid and Madrasa), on January 18, 2008. Instantly I enquired to few people like Muazzin, Khadem of Masjid and some labours whether they lost any money. They said 'NO'. I thought it was lost from any worker (Madrasa-construction work was going on ) and hence enquired my best but found no one claiming the money. Then I requested the Muazzin to make a decleration after Isha Farz Salaah among the Musallis regarding the lost money. He did so. But no one came or claimed. Then I asked a local Ulama regarding the matter and he replied, I should wait for 2 months. If in the mean time no one came to claim the money, I should give the money to poor people. 1 (one) month has already passed. I'm confused about what to do with that note. Please provide me answers for the following queries on the basis of the written matter: 1). Should I really wait for another 1 month (total 2 months) to find the owner of the money? 2). What other types of decleration should I make to find the owner? Should I make some posters and paste them on the Masjid building? 3). If I can give the money to the poor right now, waiting no further, Should I give all the money to a single poor man/woman or I can give among 50 people at same or more & less proportionate. 4). If someone asks me for a loan of 500 Taka, Can I give him that note of 500 Taka since it's in my pocket for long 1 month without being used , finding no owner? Inshallah I can give the same amount if the real owner claims the money after I give the money to someone as loan. Please, read carefully and provide all the necessary and possible annwers with available options I have. ZazakAllah 1611 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 36058 Country: India Title: I simply calculate approximately my zakah 2.5% on the total amount (balance in bank+ current value of the investments in stocks/mutual funds + provident fund balance) currently at the month of Ramadan regularly Question: Please clarify if I am right/wrong in calculating my zakah. I simply calculate approximately my zakah 2.5% on the total amount (balance in bank+ current value of the investments in stocks/mutual funds + provident fund balance) currently at the month of Ramadan regularly. I had read a Hadith in which the Prophet Muhammad PBUH had said that the excess zakah paid is just like that no zakah was paid. Answer ID: 36058 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 149/125/B=1433) We could not find any such hadith. It is right to pay 2.5% as zakah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
